kinds.next row: the number in the same column on the next row that holds a number
kinds.next column: the next number on the same row, or the one before it in the last column
kinds.wrong scale: the value times 1000, and the value divided by 1000
kinds.sign: the value with its sign changed: a negative value loses its sign, others get one
kinds.digit swap: two adjacent digits of the written number change places
kinds.other field: the value of each other field at the same year, at its own place
kinds.rounded: the written number rounded to 3 significant digits
